name: top.shixinzhang.bitmapmonitor.internal.BitmapMonitorProvider
description: AndroidBitmapMonitor initializes this provider with the app process and registers to track whether the app has visible screens, so its optional floating diagnostics panel can follow the app's visibility.
disableEffect: The app still runs, but the bitmap monitor loses this visibility tracking and its floating panel can no longer follow whether the app is visible.
